column1: # OWASP ZAP rules for the DAST scans of NF Hotel (MIL-027 tasks 6 and 7), read by
# scripts/dast-scan.sh of NF-Hotel/DevOps. One rule per line, tab separated:
# IGNORE and WARN need a reason and an expiry at most 30 days ahead; S01 approves each
# line in a reviewed pull request. A rule not listed keeps the ZAP default, and any
# High alert of a rule that is not IGNORE fails the scan.
